游戏
文/詹冰 图/林鸿堯
“小弟弟，我们来游戏。
姐姐当老师，
你当学生。”
“姐姐，那么，小妹妹呢？”
“小妹妹太小了，
她什么也不会做。
我看——
让她当校长算了。”

Text/Jian Bing Illustration/Lin Hongyao

Sister will be the teacher,
you be the student."
"Sister, then, what about little sister?"
"Little sister is too young,
she can't do anything.
I see—
let her be the principal."

Dad Comes Home
Text by Lin Liang, Illustrations by Zhao Guozong
Every time I hear you
coming home from work,
the joy in my heart
is like finally
completing a jigsaw puzzle.
Dad,
our family's puzzle
is one piece that can never be missing.

Rainy Day Duck
Text by Lin Zhonglong, Illustrations by Hong Yinan
Silver threads, one by one,
Why do they turn to water when they touch me?
Falling so fast, hitting so hard,
Why does my body not feel any pain?
Is someone playing with me?
Where is that person?
How comfortable!
Who should I thank?
The duck tucks one foot,
Tilts its head,
And thinks.

Little Sister
Text by Lin Zhonglong, Illustrations by Hong Yinan
Auntie has nice things
To share with the children

Auntie insists on giving them to her
She steps back half a step
Still shakes her head
Other children have taken them
Little sister wants them too
Little sister doesn’t turn back
Little sister runs to mom’s side

Crying and says:

Superstitious Mom
Text by Feng Huihui, Illustrations by Liu Bole
When we went to the temple to burn incense,
Mom asked for a lucky charm
and told me to hang it around my neck.
I asked Mom why.
She said this way I would get the gods' protection.
Oh dear!
Mom, you're too superstitious!
On the morning of our trip,
Mom stopped me halfway
and wiped my face and hands
with a towel soaked in mugwort water.
I asked Mom why.
She said she had just accidentally broken a bowl.
Oh dear!
Mom, you're too superstitious!

Turtle's Diary
By Du Rongchen, Illustrated by Wang Jinxuan
I've lived nearly hundreds of years,
When I say it, no one believes,
I always carry a book—
Made of my shell, a diary,
Drifting in the stormy ocean.
I've lived nearly hundreds of years,
When I say it, everyone laughs and cries,
My diary is engraved with:
Zhang Dacai six thousand,
Li Aifu three thousand,
Wang Hanzhu two thousand,
Liu Jinnian one thousand,
Cai Xingui eight hundred,
Xie Shenming five hundred,
……
A dense list of 'famous people'.
For Jinnian one thousand,
Xingui eight hundred,
Shenming five hundred,
……
A dense list of 'famous people'.
When added up, everyone jumps in surprise,
My diary is the most expensive,
All added together,
Worth at least tens of thousands.
Each time I'm mysteriously caught on shore,
Then mysteriously returned to the sea,
My fate of being caught hasn't changed,
Only the value of my diary has risen.
